I never had formal education, so I mostly learned practical math through cooking measurements and photography calculations. I appreciate the patterns in nature I see while birdwatching, which feels mathematical. But I struggle with abstract concepts. Literature and biology come more naturally to me - they tell stories. Math feels like a different language I never properly learned.
